compression/internal/codec#

The codecs behind compression/gzip, compression/deflate, compression/zlib, compression/zstd and compression/brotli: the runtime's streaming codec of a format ("deflate", "zlib", "gzip", "zstd" or "brotli"), one object per stream.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The codecs behind compression/gzip, compression/deflate, compression/zlib, compression/zstd and compression/brotli: the runtime's streaming codec of a format ("deflate", "zlib", "gzip", "zstd" or "brotli"), one object per stream. Output waits in the codec until output() takes it. An engine without a codec for the format throws UnsupportedCompression when one is made.
